connector.name: SysKnife
connector.registryDescription: Administers Linux via typed, approval-gated actions with an Ed25519-signed audit trail.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Cargo crate sysknife-cli. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lacs-project account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SYSKNIFE_SOCKET
env.description: Where the privileged daemon listens: a unix:// path, a vsock:// target, or a bare path. Defaults to wherever the daemon bound, so it is only needed for a non-default install or a remote VM.
